title: The playwright who wrote the folio of this world and wrote it badly (He gave us light first and the sun two days later
html_source:
Some mild blasphemy from Stephen. The Biblical creation story does have God creating the light and dividing it from the darkness on the first day of creation, then creating the sun, moon and stars on the fourth day of creation. See Genesis 1:3-19.

A folio is a book made of folding the papers once and binding them. Shakespeare’s works were sometimes published in folio.
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Folio
